title: AI vs. Riemann hypothesis: How AI went from fluffing simple sums to cracking the hardest math problems
paragraphs: Last year, I asked ChatGPT to add up my British state pension contributions. Thankfully, I double-checked. The total was wrong by a few pounds.
A friend who teaches math wasn't surprised. Chatbots, he said, often get simple calculations wrong.

Fast-forward to November 2026, and a mathematician working at artificial intelligence company Anthropic, Levent Alpöge, claims to have solved one of the hardest problems in mathematical history with the help of the company's chatbot, Claude.
